description: Grundfos E-pumps (MAGNA3, MGE motors, CUE drives) through the CIM 200 / CIU 200 Modbus RTU, CIM 500 Modbus TCP or built-in SoftCIM: control, setpoint, status, alarms, head, flow, power, energy, temperatures and heat energy
source: Grundfos, Modbus for Grundfos pumps, functional profile and user manual, 98367081 05.2025

sources.title: Modbus for Grundfos pumps, functional profile and user manual

notes: Modbus RTU through the CIM 200 / CIU 200 module or the pump's built-in SoftCIM, Modbus TCP through the CIM 500. CIM 200 defaults: 19200 bit/s, even parity, 1 stop bit; address and speed by DIP switches or software settings (registers 00003-00010).

Register numbers are those of the manual, counted from 1: register 00104 is sent as 103 (address_base 1). All registers can be read with function 03 or 04; the control and configuration blocks are written with 06 or 16.
32-bit values are two registers, high word first (the names end in HI and LO in the manual).
A value of 0xFFFF means the data is not available on this pump or without the sensor; the manual marks which registers each model supports.
Written from the manufacturer's functional profile; not tested on a device.

registers.name: Slave minimum reply delay
registers.description: SlaveMinimumReplyDelay. The minimum reply delay from the slave in ms. Value range: 0-10000, i.e. up to 10 seconds reply delay. This delay is typically used in conjunction with a modem. The delay value is stored in the device and remains after a power-off. The delay set here is added to the internal delay in the device. Default setting: 0. Note that this is not supported by the built-in SoftCIM Modbus RTU.

registers.name: Software defined modbus address
registers.description: SoftwareDefinedModbusAddress. This register holds the active Modbus address. The default value is 0xE7 (231), and there is normally no need to change this value. Note that for the CIM 200, this value is used only when you set the transmission speed to "Software-defined" on DIP switches SW4 and SW5. Otherwise, the CIM 200 ignores it.

registers.name: Software defined bit rate

enum.0: 1200 bit/s (Not supported by the SoftCIM Modbus RTU)
enum.1: 2400 bit/s (Not supported by the SoftCIM Modbus RTU)
enum.2: 4800 bit/s (Not supported by the SoftCIM Modbus RTU)

registers.description: SoftwareDefinedBitRate. Modbus software-defined value for transmission speed. The software-defined value for transmission speed is stored in the device and remains after a power-off. Note that for the CIM 200, this value is used only when you set the transmission speed to "software-defined" on DIP switches SW4 and SW5. Otherwise, the CIM 200 ignores it.

registers.name: Auto ack control bits
registers.description: AutoAckControlBits. Used for selecting the behaviour of control bit acknowledgements from the CIM/CIU Control bits are not automatically lowered when accepted by the device. The user must lower the triggered control bit manually before the control bit can be triggered again. Control bits are automatically lowered when accepted by the device. The user does not have to lower it manually.

registers.name: Software defined parity
registers.description: SoftwareDefinedParity. Parity setting when using software-defined settings. Note that for the CIM 200, this value is used only when the transmission speed is set to "software-defined" on DIP switches SW4 and SW5. Otherwise, the CIM 200 ignores it.

registers.name: Software defined stop bit
registers.description: SoftwareDefinedStopBit. Stop bit setting when using software-defined settings Note that for the CIM 200, this value is used only when the transmission speed is set to "software-defined" on DIP switches SW4 and SW5. Otherwise, the CIM 200 ignores it.

registers.name: Watchdog
registers.description: Watchdog. Configuration of watchdog timeout [5; 3600 s], default: Disabled='0', minimum value 5 s • Watchdog is fed whenever the device is addressed by a valid telegram. • An interruption of telegrams for over the timeout activates the watchdog. • Action: The pump is set to Local mode. • Values 1-4: set timeout to 5 s. Values >3600: set timeout to 3600 s.

registers.name: Genibus diode off

enum.0: GENIbus diode LED2 has normal function
enum.1: GENIbus diode LED2 is permanently switched off

registers.description: GENIbusDiodeOff. For disabling the CIM 200 or CIM 500 GENIbus LED2

registers.name: Genibus CRC error count
registers.description: GENIbusCRCErrorCnt. It holds a CRC error counter for the GENIbus connection to the E-pump.

registers.name: Genibus data error count
registers.description: GENIbusDataErrorCnt. It holds a data error counter for the GENIbus connection to the E-pump.

registers.name: Version number
registers.description: VersionNumber. A Grundfos-specific version number, BCD coded unsigned integer value.

registers.name: Actual modbus address
registers.description: ActualModbusAddress. It holds the current Modbus slave address of the device. Valid value range: 1-247

registers.name: Genibus TX count
registers.description: GENIbusTXcountHI. It holds a transmit counter for the total number of telegrams sent to the E-pump on the GENIbus connection.

registers.name: Genibus RX count
registers.description: GENIbusRXcountHI. It holds a receive counter for the total number of telegrams received from the E-pump on the GENIbus connection.

registers.name: Unit type

registers.name: Unit version

registers.name: Product software year
registers.description: ProductSoftwareYear. Product software date (BCD yyyy)

registers.name: Remote access request
registers.description: Control bit that sets local or remote control Set this bit to 1 if a Modbus master should control the E-pump. You can read the actual status from register 00201 bit 8. 0 = Local; 1 = Remote (controlled by Modbus master)

registers.name: On off request
registers.description: Control bit that switches the E-pump on or off You can read the actual status from register 00201 bit 9. 0 = Off (stop); 1 = On (start)

registers.name: Reset alarm
registers.description: Control bit that resets alarms and warnings from the E-pump This control bit is triggered on rising edge only, i.e. setting logical 0 to 1. See section CIM configuration register block , address 00005 for acknowledgement behaviour. 0 = No resetting; 1 = Resetting alarm

registers.name: Copy to local
registers.description: Control bit that enables copying of remote settings to local pump settings Only available on MAGNA3, CUE and MGE model H and later You can read the actual status from register 00201 bit 1. Note that copy of the Control Context, which is Control mode, Operating mode, On/off and Setpoint, from the remote setting to the local setting takes place when CopyToLocal has been enabled, but only during a Re

registers.name: Enable max flow limit
registers.description: Control bit that enables or disables the FLOWLIMIT function Set the maximum flow limit value in register 00106. Only available on MAGNA3 and MGE model H and later You can read the actual status from register 00201 bit 2. 0 = Disabled (only used in control mode FLOWADAPT); 1 = Enabled (used in all control modes)

registers.name: Control mode
registers.description: ControlMode. Control bit that sets the control mode enumeration Note that some modes are not supported by all E-pumps. You can read the actual control mode from register 00203.

registers.name: Operation mode

enum.0: Auto-control (setpoint control according to selected control mode)

registers.description: OperationMode. A state enumeration to control the E-pump operating mode Note that "OnOffReq" has higher priority than "OperationMode", that is, you must set "OnOffReq" to "On" for "OperationMode" to have any effect. You can read the actual operation mode from register 00204.

registers.name: Setpoint
registers.description: Setpoint. It sets the E-pump setpoint. The scale is 0.01 %, so the value must be from 0 to 10000 to represent the entire 0-100 % range. Closed loop: Percentage of setpoint range Open loop Percentage of nominal frequency Common examples 4700: 47 % 8000: 80 % You can read the actual setpoint from register 00338 UserSetpoint.

registers.name: Relay control: Relay 1 control
registers.description: Controls the state of relay 1 Only E-pumps and CUE 0 = Closed; 1 = Open

registers.name: Relay control: Relay 2 control
registers.description: Controls the state of relay 2. Only CUE, large MGE, MGE model H and later 0 = Closed; 1 = Open

registers.name: Relay control: Relay 3 control
registers.description: Controls the state of relay 3 Only MGE model H and later 0 = Closed; 1 = Open

registers.name: Relay control: Relay 4 control
registers.description: Controls the state of relay 4 Only MGE model H and later 0 = Closed; 1 = Open

registers.name: Set max flow limit
registers.description: SetMaxFlowLimit. It sets the maximum flow limit: FLOWLIMIT. It must be enabled in register 00101, bit 5. m3/h. The value is set in 0.01 If enabled, the FLOWLIMIT is active in all control modes. If disabled, the maximum flow limit is only active in FLOWADAPT control mode. Read the actual value in register 00345. Only available on MAGNA3 and MGE model H and later

registers.name: Set pump unix RTC
registers.description: SetPumpUnixRtcHI. It sets the real-time clock in the pump in unix format (seconds since 01-01-1970). Only available on MAGNA3 and MGE model H and later.

registers.name: Sensor feedback
registers.description: SensorFeedback. Closed loop sensor feedback via Modbus, scaling 0.01 %

registers.name: Set Kp
registers.description: SetKp. It sets the proportional gain, Kp. The scale is 0.1. Only available on MAGNA3 and MGE model H and later

registers.name: Set Ti
registers.description: SetTi. It sets the integral action time, Ti. The scale is 0.1 s. Only available on MAGNA3 and MGE model H and later

registers.name: Set direct ctr
registers.description: SetDirectCtr. Selection of Direct/Inverse control Only available on MAGNA3 and MGE model H and later

registers.name: Low flow stop
registers.description: It indicates if the state of "Low Flow Stop" function is active or not active. Only available on MGE model H and later 0 = Pump is not in "Low Flow Stop" state; 1 = Pump is in "Low Flow Stop" state

registers.name: Copy to local (status)
registers.description: It indicates if the remote settings of setpoint, operating mode, control mode and on/off state will be automatically copied to local settings. Only available on MAGNA3 and MGE model H and later 0 = Copying disabled; 1 = Copying enabled

registers.name: Max flow limit enabled
registers.description: It indicates if the MaxFlowLimit is enabled. Enable it with register 00101, bit 5. Only available on MAGNA3 and MGE model H and later 0 = Disabled; 1 = Enabled

registers.name: Reset alarm ack
registers.description: It indicates if a ResetAlarm command was acknowledged by the device. This bit is set when the CIU has accepted a ResetAlarm command, and the programmer can clear the ResetAlarm bit. The ResetAlarmAck bit is automatically cleared to 0 by the CIU when the ResetAlarm bit is cleared by the master device, and a new ResetAlarm command can be attempted by raising the ResetAlarm bit again. This functional

registers.name: Setpoint influence
registers.description: It indicates if setpoint influence is active. Only available on MAGNA3 and MGE model H and later 0 = Not active; 1 = Active

registers.name: At max power
registers.description: It indicates if the E-pump is running at its power limit. Only available on MAGNA3 and MGE model H and later 0 = Not running at power limit; 1 = Running at power limit

registers.name: Rotation
registers.description: It indicates if the E-pump is rotating, that is running, or not. 0 = No rotation; 1 = Rotation

registers.name: Direction
registers.description: It indicates the current rotational direction of the E-pump as seen from the ventilator side. 0 = Clockwise; 1 = Counterclockwise

registers.name: Access mode
registers.description: It indicates if the E-pump is locally or remotely controlled. 0 = Local (a local control source with higher priority controls the E-pump); 1 = Remote (controlled by Modbus master)

registers.name: On off
registers.description: It indicates if the E-pump is on or off. Started does not necessarily indicate rotation, for instance in case of low-flow stop. 0 = Off (stopped, the green LED on the E-pump flashes); 1 = On (started, the green LED on the E-pump is on)

registers.name: Alarm
registers.description: It indicates if there is an alarm or not. 0 = No alarm; 1 = Alarm (red LED on the E-pump is on)

registers.name: Warning
registers.description: It indicates if there is a warning or not. The E-pump will continue running even if there is a warning. 0 = No warning; 1 = Warning (red LED on the E-pump is on)

registers.name: Forced to local
registers.description: State of the "Forced to local" control option Only available on MAGNA3 and MGE model H and later 0 = Not forced to local; 1 = Forced to local

registers.name: At max speed
registers.description: It indicates if the E-pump is running at maximum speed. 0 = No; 1 = Yes

registers.name: At min speed
registers.description: It indicates if the E-pump is running at minimum speed. 0 = No; 1 = Yes

registers.name: Process feedback
registers.description: ProcessFeedback. It indicates the actual process feedback from the E-pump. The scale is 0.01 %, so the valid value range is from 0 to 10000. This value can be compared with the setpoint value. Closed loop: Percentage of closed-loop feedback sensor range Open loop: Percentage of E-pump performance Common examples: 4700: 47 % 8000: 80 %

registers.name: Control mode (status)
registers.description: ControlMode. It indicates the actual control mode. Not all modes are supported by all E-pump types.

registers.name: Operation mode (status)

enum.0: Auto-control (normal, setpoint control according to selected control mode)

registers.description: OperationMode. It indicates the actual operating mode.

registers.description: AlarmCode. The Grundfos-specific alarm code.

registers.name: Warning code
registers.description: WarningCode. The Grundfos-specific warning code.

registers.name: Months to bearing service
registers.description: It indicates the number of months until the next bearing service (not available on all E-pumps). This value can be 0, 1, 3, 6, 12 and 24 months, if available. A value of 24 months means "24 months or more". A value of 0xFF indicates that the information is not available.

registers.name: Bearing service type
